title: A reconstructed transition between effective models is Cartesian
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a singleton fpqc covering of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For each affine open $A$ of $S$, put $X_A=X\times_S A$ and $V_A=V\times_X X_A$, for a scheme $V\to X$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $W_A\to A$ and $r_A:V_A\to W_A$ exhibit $V_A$ as $W_A\times_A X_A$. For an inclusion $i:U\hookrightarrow B$ of affine opens, let $c_i:V_U\to V_B$ be the canonical restriction map. If $t:W_U\to W_B$ satisfies $t\,p_B=p_U\,i$ and $r_U\,t=c_i\,r_B$, then the square with edges $t,p_U,p_B,i$ is Cartesian. No descent datum or invariance hypothesis is needed once the reconstruction equation is assumed.

proof.text: Form P = W_B times_B U and the induced map k : W_U -> P. Pasting the B-model Cartesian square with the canonical restriction pullback squares identifies the pullback of P to X_U with V_U. The U-model square makes the same identification for W_U. Reconstruction identifies the base change of k with the identity under these identifications.

The singleton X_U -> U is fpqc by base change of f. Apply full faithfulness of fpqc descent of morphisms to descend the inverse of the base-changed k; inverse compatibility follows by inverting the compatibility of k. Faithfulness gives the two inverse identities, so k is an isomorphism. Compose k with the pullback square defining P to obtain the claimed Cartesian square.

proof_origin.place: Tag 02W3, nested affine comparison; full faithfulness from Tag 02W0. The auxiliary statement isolates the Cartesian verification after reconstruction.

lean.statement:
theorem fpqc_affine_model_transition_cartesian
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hf : Presieve.singleton f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S)
    {V : Over X}
    (W : ∀ U : S.affineOpens, Over U.1.toScheme)
    (r : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      pullback V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι) ⟶ (W U).left)
    (hp : ∀ U, IsPullback (r U) (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))
      (W U).hom (pullback.snd f U.1.ι))
    {U B : S.affineOpens} (i : U ⟶ B)
    (t : (W U).left ⟶ (W B).left)
    (ht : t ≫ (W B).hom = (W U).hom ≫ S.directedAffineCover.trans i)
    (hr : Scheme.Cover.trans ((S.directedAffineCover.pullback₁ f).pullback₁ V.hom) i ≫
      r B = r U ≫ t) :
    IsPullback t (W U).hom (W B).hom (S.directedAffineCover.trans i)
